description: This file defines the Creatable interface in Java, which specifies methods for tracking creation metadata such as creator user and creation date for domain objects in the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: Creatable
classes.description: An interface for domain objects that track creation metadata, including creator user and creation date.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Returns the user who created the object.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Sets the user who created the object.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the date when the object was created.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date of the object.
